answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, published publicly on failure, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. A atlas of per-task receipts records who did what, and the inlet of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The lotus of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
